name: Ysabet Crowthorne
source_profile:
Dame Ysabet Crowthorne: "The Saint of Ashes" (LE) 
Dame Ysabet Crowthorne was once a highly respected knight 
of the northern nobility and a devoted commander in one of 
Cador's many knightly orders. She earned her infamous epithet 
during the final months of the war, when she ordered the 
destruction of several villages suspected of provisioning the 
royalist armies. Following the rebellion's defeat, Crowthorne fled 
east with a handful of surviving knights and their retainers. 
Unlike other outlaw commanders, she refuses to acknowledge 
that the civil war has ended. 
Dame Ysabet Crowthorne of the Ashen Vow regards the repeal of the bloodline decree as 
meaningless because the northern houses it threatened have already been destroyed. 
Reputation: Crowthorne is feared even among the other northern outlaws. The Ashen Vow has 
become synonymous with religious extremism, executions, and burned settlements. 
Adventure hook: Marquessa Elowen Harrowmont receives a letter bearing the seal of a 
knightly order abolished after the war. It demands she renounce her title and swear allegiance to 
the fallen northern lords. The letter is accompanied by the severed hand of one of her rangers.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 38–38 (source excerpt)
